mechanism: Systemic corticosteroid absorption from ophthalmic prednisolone may counteract the antihypertensive and renoprotective effects of benazepril ACE inhibitor, while benazepril may increase hyperkalemia risk if corticosteroid-induced hypokalemia is present.
action: Monitor blood pressure and serum potassium periodically; ophthalmic prednisolone at therapeutic doses typically poses minimal systemic risk, but prolonged use warrants caution in patients on ACE inhibitors.
